page.overview:
Who is Damien Webb?

Damien Webb is the secondary antagonist of the 2026 James Bond video game, 007 First Light. He is the lethal, and physically imposing son of tech billionaire Sir Nicholas Webb . He is played by Bart Edwards.

Damien Webb is a psychotic, spoiled, and explosive sociopath with a clear lack of sympathy for the lives of others, acting as his father's personal assassin with the intention of silencing most of the victims of the errors caused by THEIA, his father's experimental quantum supercomputer. Damien is also a kind of "catastrophe fixer," making most of THEIA's erroneous and poorly calculated catastrophes a reality in order to sell it to MI6. Damien functions as a "dark mirror" of James Bond. While Bond channels his traumas into duty and principles, Damien has succumbed to his violent impulses, becoming a sadistic but extremely charismatic, ironic, and witty killing machine.

He has a deep sense of inferiority towards his father and blames him for his mother's death when he was younger. Unlike Bond, who transformed the tragedy of his parents' death into a catalyst to move forward and do good, Damien uses his mother's death as an excuse to inflict pain and suffering on innocents, as well as to try to justify his character flaws. Although physically imposing, his insecurity is reflected in most of the costumes and weaponry he uses, such as eco-powered super-armor and heavy firearms. This shows that Damien doesn't always consider himself an equal to his opponents. However, he would never admit it. A narcissist by nature, Damien considers himself better and more important than everyone around him, and this ends up being his biggest mistake, underestimating James Bond's ability and improvisation skills.
